procedure: NVDA + Firefox/Chrome and VoiceOver + Safari: read headings/landmarks, labels, description, dialog name and modal boundary.
With screen reader enabled, submit empty/invalid form, correct it and complete simulation. Verify error and success are announced once at the right time.
Keyboard through all controls; inspect visible, unobscured focus, sensible reading order and modal entry/exit at zoom and with assistive technology.
Check 200%/400% browser zoom, text spacing, landscape, touch targets, forced colors and real mobile devices. 320px overflow smoke does not establish conformance.
Review instructions, error clarity, contrast in all states and remaining applicable WCAG 2.2 A/AA criteria; record reviewer, browser/AT versions and evidence.
